column1: # Declared frame divergences for DEMO1, in tests/doom/compare.rb's format:
#   stream
# One file per demo because a gametic is not unique across demos.
# Values measured 2026-09-11 on macOS arm64 -- the toolchain decision 0006
# selects -- with the reference built by Clang 23.1.1 at doomgeneric
# dcb7a8db and the port on pin cad0ad14 with the same --cc.  Extracted from
# the macOS side's saved logs (build/mac-review-361721b/DEMO1.log, their
# exec 31602); not regenerated from a failing run here, and nothing in this
# repository can write this file.
# The reasons cite the predecessor's records at f8ad13c6 and name the field
# read.  They do not copy values from those records: the values here are the
# 2026-09 measurement.  The mechanism itself has NOT been re-confirmed -- the
# byte-window instrument those records used has not been re-run, and a frame
# hash cannot see which byte differed.
# Known fragility, recorded rather than worked around: the bytes these tics
# depend on are pointers and allocation history, so they are not a function of
# the WAD and are not guaranteed stable across reference builds.  They are not:
# a Debian-built reference disagrees with this one at DEMO1 4486 and DEMO2 631.
# If a value here stops matching, that is the gate working -- a changed
# discrepancy is for investigation, and the first thing to check is whether the
# reference build changed.
frames
